title: Singapore MOE — P5 Standard Electrical System
version: 2023 Primary Science Teaching and Learning Syllabus

objectives.title: Circuits as electrical systems
objectives.paraphrase: Recognise that a battery, wires, bulbs and switches together form an electrical system.
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: recognise that a circuit made of an energy source (battery) and other components (wire, bulb, switch) forms an electrical system. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code.

objectives.title: Closed circuits
objectives.paraphrase: Understand that a closed circuit permits current to flow.
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: understand that a closed circuit permits current to flow. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code. Alignment remains subject to teacher review.

objectives.title: Electrical conductors and insulators
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: identify electrical conductors and insulators. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code. The demonstration tests inference from observations, not a practical construction skill.

objectives.title: Circuit diagrams
objectives.paraphrase: Construct simple circuits from circuit diagrams.
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: construct simple circuits from circuit diagrams. A written MCQ can assess reading a circuit diagram and predicting what the built circuit does; it cannot assess hands-on construction. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code.

objectives.title: Batteries and bulbs in series and parallel
objectives.paraphrase: Investigate how the number of batteries in series and the number of bulbs in series or parallel affect the current in a circuit.
objectives.description: Paraphrased outcome: investigate the effect of the number of batteries (arranged in series) and the number of bulbs (arranged in series and parallel) on the current in a circuit. Bulb brightness is the qualitative sign of current. Foundation Science (page 60) covers bulbs in series only. This ID is an internal mapping label, not an official MOE code.

excludedOutcomes.reason: Values outcome (conserving electricity, proper use and handling). These MCQs do not assess attitudes.

scopeRules.text: Reason qualitatively. Do not use voltage, resistance, measured current, their units or meters.
scopeRules.basis: Page 59 asks how variables affect the current; it names no quantities, units or meters. These are secondary-school content.
Page 59 lists the number of batteries arranged in series.

scopeRules.text: Use batteries only; no mains electricity, power points or household wiring.
scopeRules.basis: Classroom investigations on page 59 use batteries; the values outcome asks for proper handling of electricity.
Short circuits are not among the page 59 outcomes.

assessment.title: PSLE Science — for examination from 2026
assessment.note: The demonstration borrows the four-option, two-mark MCQ format and application/data-interpretation objective. It is a P5 practice item, not an official PSLE question. Source requirements do not establish empirical difficulty or originality.
